description:
`discord-to-msg` accepts the messages the WebhookBridge Discord bot forwards from a Discord channel and converts each into UnitySVC's native `msg` format, posted into one of your rooms.

WebhookBridge watches a Discord channel and forwards each new message as JSON (`message`, `display_name`, `message_id`, `attachments`, …). The service maps that event onto the `msg` fields a room takes — the text as `body` (Discord markdown kept as `markdown`), the attachment URLs, and an `origin` of `discord` carrying the Discord message id and the author's display name — and posts it into the room as the member of the connector it came in through, attributed to that connector. The message id doubles as the idempotency key, so a redelivered event is not posted twice. When the room also sends to that Discord channel through msg-to-discord, WebhookBridge forwards those posts back as new events; with DISCORD_WEBHOOK_ID set, the gateway answers such an echo (its user_id is your webhook's id) with 204 before anything is posted. Free.

In UnitySVC open Rooms → the room → Delivery, add a connector for the Discord channel (or use `main`) and choose Discord to Messages as its inbound service; give WebhookBridge the URL the connector shows as the channel's destination. Several Discord channels into several rooms are several connectors. No enrollment to set up; the one optional secret, DISCORD_WEBHOOK_ID, stops your own outbound messages coming back. See “How to use this service” for the walkthrough.
name: discord-to-msg
summary: Bring Discord messages into a UnitySVC room: WebhookBridge posts each message here, the gateway converts it into a `msg` and delivers it through your room connector.
